xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5540: Known skill packs (the video group) can't be discovered or added outside the CLI; agents don't know they exist

plan.title: Known skill packs (the video group) can't be discovered or added outside the CLI; agents don't know they exist
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Known skill packs (the video group from PAN-5464, plus pstack, sageox, atlassian, gstack, mattpocock, deft) ship with URLs and pinned commits in KNOWN_PACKS, but nothing outside the CLI verb lists or adds them: the Skills page shows one hard-coded mattpocock command, the new-conversation skills field lists only registered packs, pan skills pack list never says what is not added, no shipped skill tells agents, and the docs omit the video packs' default refs.
narratives.Proposal: Add a known-pack listing core (src/lib/skill-packs/known.ts) used by pan skills pack list and GET /api/skills/packs/available; add a two-step preview/add core over the existing addPack(input, confirm) (confirm compares the previewed commit) behind POST /api/skills/packs/preview and POST /api/skills/packs (id-only bodies, admin scope, per-id in-process lock); render an Available packs list with an AddPacksDialog trust flow on the Skills page and a not-added-groups row in the new-conversation skills field; ship a pan-skills bundled skill for agents; update docs and changelog. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-5540.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Adding custom (non-known) packs, choosing a ref, or choosing an adapter from the dashboard
- Adding mattpocock, deft, gstack or sageox from the dashboard (they stay CLI-only: no default ref or a build step)
- Updating, removing or syncing packs, or toggling gstack's browser runtime, from the dashboard
- Turning packs on from the add dialog
- An MCP tool for adding packs
- A cross-process lock between the CLI and the dashboard
- A license field on KnownPack
- Any change to pan skills pack list --json output
- A universal rule for pack discovery
- Cleaning up the clone/extraction a declined or abandoned preview leaves on disk
- Accepting url, ref or adapter in any new HTTP request body

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard Add is offered only for known packs with a default url and ref and no build step (pstack, atlassian, remotion, hyperframes, openmontage, video-use); mattpocock, deft, gstack and sageox are listed with their CLI command. This narrows the issue acceptance sentence 'each known pack with an Add action': all ten are listed, six get Add; the video group is fully addable.
autoDecisions.rationale: Packs without a default ref need an operator choice the issue does not define a UI for, and gstack/sageox run bash setup or go build at add time, which can take minutes and download toolchains inside an HTTP request.

autoDecisions.summary: Trust over HTTP is two requests: preview returns the PackPreview; add re-runs addPack with confirm = preview.commit === previewed commit, else 409 commit-changed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps one registration path (addPack), needs no server-side preview session, and guarantees the operator trusts exactly the commit they saw.

autoDecisions.summary: New request bodies accept only a known pack id (plus commit); any url/ref/adapter key is rejected.
autoDecisions.rationale: Otherwise the dashboard becomes an arbitrary git clone endpoint.

autoDecisions.summary: License is shown only in the preview (from the fetched manifest); KnownPack gets no license field.
autoDecisions.rationale: License is derived from the repo at the commit; a static copy would drift.

autoDecisions.summary: A group add is one dialog with all member previews and one Trust button, then one add request per member, skipping registered members and continuing past failures.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the CLI's addGroupPacks semantics and keeps each HTTP request short.

autoDecisions.summary: The Available packs list renders only at the global level of the skill overrides panel; project/issue levels link to the Skills page.
autoDecisions.rationale: The pack registry is global; showing the list in issue drawers would add noise.

autoDecisions.summary: The new-conversation field shows only groups (not single packs) and opens AddPacksDialog nested in place.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for groups there; navigating to /skills would drop the open dialog's state, and Modal supports nesting.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent guidance ships as a new pan-skills CLI-wrapper bundled skill, not a universal rule.
autoDecisions.rationale: A rule costs context in every session; a skill costs only its description line, which carries the trigger words. No pan skills wrapper existed.

autoDecisions.summary: pan skills pack list --json stays unchanged; the known-pack section is text-only.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5464 D-2 kept groups text-only to avoid changing the JSON row contract.

autoDecisions.summary: The per-id guard is in-process only: a second preview of the same id shares the running preview; an add while anything for that id runs returns 409 busy.
autoDecisions.rationale: Sharing previews keeps a reopened dialog and React StrictMode double effects from erroring; the CLI already races with itself on the same clone, so a cross-process lock is out of scope.

metadata.sizeJustification: One user-facing capability (discover and add known packs) that must land across lib, CLI, server routes, frontend, a bundled skill and docs to be useful; the subsystem count is inflated because the lint counts each top-level doc file (docs/USAGE.md, docs/SKILL-PACKS.md, configuration/skills.mdx, features/skill-packs.mdx, changelog.d) as its own subsystem. Items are vertical slices with explicit edges.
